message.content:
# THE CEO STASH

## THE COMPLEX

The ash field rests far by the old entry. The complex rises out of the ruins. Its spire bears the brand of the old corps. The storm howls in the empty halls.

## THE LOOTERS

Three raiders cross the entry. Their kit makes noise. Their eye scans the black.

## THE TWO

The two see an android below the vault, another. The two units sit in the black. Their metal shell bears the brand of the old chief. The two are deactivated. The two are still.

The two are coded as chief execs. Their thought codes are the key. No other can crack the vault.

## THE STASH

The pre-War techs are in the vault by the two. The vault holds the final of the old world. Its doors sit in the grasp of the two.

The techs in the vault can shift the world. Power cells, medical units, weapons of the old corps.

## THE BET

To crack the vault, the raiders can start the two. The two are deactivated. Their power cells are drained. The raiders can scour the way to restart the two.

But the two are not key. The two are chief execs. If the two awake, the two can command. The two can steer the raiders, or the raiders say no.

The two can share the techs, or the two can own the raiders. The raiders own the final say.
